title: EV Charging Project Evidence and Cases | Anari Energy
meta: Deployed charging projects with site context, configuration and outcome: bus depots, highway corridors, hot-climate and cold-climate sites across 22 countries.

sections.h1: Every claim on this site should be checkable against a site.
sections.lede: These are 9 documented case studies, not concepts: the site context, the configuration that was installed, and what happened after commissioning — including the conditions the equipment had to survive.
sections.credit: Dual-gun 120 kW corridor deployment, Central Asia

sections.eyebrow: How to read a case page
sections.h2: Same four facts on every project
sections.lede: A case page is only useful if it states the conditions. Each one carries: what the site needed, what was installed, the constraint that shaped the decision, and the measured outcome.
